purpose: Refuse DWG ELLIPSE writer inputs whose ratio or plane geometry cannot be represented as a valid AutoCAD ellipse.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.wireMapping: DWG carries WCS center and semi-major-axis vector, extrusion, minor/major ratio, and eccentric-anomaly start/end parameters.

nativeContract.source: Autodesk ObjectARX AcDbEllipse::setRadiusRatio and AcDbEllipse::set references
nativeContract.requirements: Radius ratio is in [1e-6, 1.0]; major axis and normal are nondegenerate; major axis is perpendicular to normal within 1e-6.

implementation.behavior: Before staging output, the DWG ELLIPSE encoder requires finite center, axis, normal, ratio and parameters; ratio in [1e-6, 1.0]; axis and normal magnitudes above the documented degeneracy threshold; and normalized axis/normal alignment within 1e-6. Vector checks scale before normalization to avoid overflow/underflow artifacts.
implementation.scope: DWG writer admission; DWG reader behavior remains tolerant and unchanged.

generatedControls.failureRetry: Each refused output preserves a seeded destination; corrected ratio-0.5 output succeeds through the same dwgRW instance and reads back all modeled fields with zero entity/object parse failures. Separate boundary outputs read back at ratios 1e-6 and 1.0.
generatedControls.fixturePolicy: All source records are authored by the test in scratch storage; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

limitations: This proves generated writer admission and readback only; physical producer prevalence, native rendering and whole-document qualification remain open.
The broader P6 version/schema/no-loss gate remains open.
supportClaimEffect: Closes a bounded DWG ELLIPSE writer geometry-admission gap; no broad DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
